provenance: Independently authored expectations for seven preserved policies exposed from defaults and pack consumers. Original immutable fixtures are unchanged. Small tolerances retain exact numeric values; the existing four-decimal ledger text formatter displays zero.

assumption_rows.name: small_part_routing_factor
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME small_part_routing_factor      = 3.5           ratio      [policy] board_decision_policy.floorplan.small_part_routing_factor — area multiplier for small-part routing reserve; also reported by the plan

assumption_rows.name: point_segment_tolerance
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME point_segment_tolerance        = 0             mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.pack.point_segment_tolerance_mm — axis recognition and endpoint tolerance in point-on-segment tests

assumption_rows.name: visual_axis_tolerance
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME visual_axis_tolerance          = 0             mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.pack.visual_axis_tolerance_mm — axis recognition and strict interior tolerance in visual crossing tests

assumption_rows.name: collinear_overlap_tolerance
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME collinear_overlap_tolerance    = 0             mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.pack.collinear_overlap_tolerance_mm — axis recognition and minimum strict collinear overlap

assumption_rows.name: segment_cross_tolerance
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME segment_cross_tolerance        = 0             mm^2       [policy] board_decision_policy.pack.segment_cross_tolerance_mm2 — signed cross-product threshold for strict segment intersection

assumption_rows.name: label_courtyard_gap
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME label_courtyard_gap            = 0.9           mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.pack.label_courtyard_gap_mm — clear-label search offset outside the footprint courtyard

assumption_rows.name: label_orbit_tau
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME label_orbit_tau                = 6.2832        radian     [policy] board_decision_policy.pack.label_orbit_tau — established full-turn double used by the sixteen-angle label orbit
